items.title: [Steam论坛] Hard mode bug, please help
items.summary:
After completing Chapter 2 on Hard Mode, Chapter 3 on Hard Mode does not unlock.

Requirements shown in-game

The game states that the requirements to unlock Chapter 3 on Hard Mode are:

Complete Chapter 3.5 on Normal Mode
Complete Chapter 2 on Hard Mode

I have completed both requirements, but Chapter 3 on Hard Mode is still locked....
items.author: Vsolqt
